Definition: Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ahaz = "he has grasped"; 1) king of Judah, son Jotham, father of Hezekiah; 2) a Benjamite, son of Micah, and great grandson of Jonathan
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
